design_name: MacroPulse paper robustness and sensitivity analysis

alternative_model_rule.eligibility: candidate must have valid forecasts at every stage used for the target on the development common sample
alternative_model_rule.selection: runner-up pooled development MSE model after excluding the primary fixed comparator
alternative_model_rule.selection_sample: same primary development sample used for the frozen fixed comparator

evaluation.comparisons: same adjacent-stage pairs as primary H1
evaluation.inference: same Newey-West HAC rule as confirmatory analysis

exercises.name: H1 alternative fixed-model sensitivity
exercises.purpose: Test whether the H1 information-arrival conclusion depends on the single primary fixed model chosen for each target.
report: all adjacent-stage mean loss differentials and raw p-values
count of nominal 5% improvements and deteriorations

evaluation.inference: same Newey-West HAC rule as confirmatory H2
evaluation.same_model_ties: reported as mechanical ties and excluded from informative comparison counts

exercises.name: H2 shortened-development policy stability
exercises.purpose: Test whether the stage-policy conclusions depend on using observations close to the original policy freeze.
report: mapping changes relative to the primary freeze
all informative target-stage loss differentials and raw p-values

selection_rules.fixed_comparator: same pooled development MSE then MAE then model-name rule
selection_rules.post_cutoff_pre_evaluation_observations: excluded from selection and retained only as an unused gap before the unchanged evaluation sample
selection_rules.stage_policy: same target-stage minimum development MSE rule and original tie breaks

exercises.inputs: archived H3 stage-level results only; no H3 forecast regeneration
exercises.name: H3 stage-level vintage heterogeneity
exercises.purpose: Determine whether target-level vintage conclusions are broad across release stages or concentrated in individual stages.
report: stage-level squared-error and absolute-error differentials for every target-stage cell
number of stages favouring latest vintage
whether target-level conclusions are driven by one stage

rules.sample: all available paired RT/LV stage cells from the archived H3 design

evaluation.inference: same Newey-West HAC bandwidth rule as frozen H4
evaluation.paired_comparison: variant interval score minus frozen primary H4 interval score

invariants.scope: same target, stage, and frozen selected model

exercises.name: H4 calibration-memory sensitivity
exercises.purpose: Test sensitivity of empirical interval performance to reasonable shorter- and longer-memory choices without changing the no-look-ahead gate.
report: all stage-cell metrics for baseline and both variants
whether substantive H4 conclusions change under shorter or longer memory

exercises.name: Multiplicity sensitivity
exercises.purpose: Assess how cell-level significance statements change under transparent family-wise error control.
report: raw and Holm-adjusted p-values for every test
no replacement of primary unadjusted confirmatory inference

explicitly_out_of_scope_for_this_robustn: new nonlinear or machine-learning model classes
new factor dimensions, ridge penalties, or forecast-combination hyperparameter sweeps
alternative release-stage boundary reconstruction requiring new upstream vintage data
alternative H3 latest-vintage definitions requiring new external vintage acquisition
principles: All confirmatory H1-H4 outputs remain immutable and primary.
Robustness analyses are secondary and may not be used to redefine the confirmatory hypotheses, samples, policies, or interval methods.
No confirmatory output file may be regenerated or overwritten.
Where possible, robustness analyses reuse frozen source backtests and archived per-origin outputs rather than refitting production models.
All new selection rules use only pre-evaluation development observations.
Evaluation starts remain GDP 2023Q2 and Inflation/Labour 2023-02.
Loss signs retain the confirmatory conventions.
Robustness results will be reported comprehensively according to the rules below, not selected by statistical significance.
status: post-confirmatory robustness design frozen before new robustness computations
